title: SWS: No social protection for over a third of fuel aid beneficiaries

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — More than a third of beneficiaries who received P5,000 in fuel assistance from the government were not enrolled in any government program, including the Social Security System (SSS) and PhilHealth, a Social Weather Stations (SWS) survey found. The survey, released by the Office of the Executive Secretary (OES) on Tuesday, was commissioned by the Australian government’s Social Protection, Inclusion and Gender Equality (Spring) Program. It was conducted by the SWS on May 26 and 27 among 1,200 registered Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) cash-relief beneficiaries under the government’s Unified Package for Livelihoods, Industry, Food, and Transport (Uplift) […]...
